description: This file defines a React functional component called Topbar, which displays an application label and user action buttons (Home, Login, Logout) based on authentication state. It manages navigation on button clicks and interacts with an authentication context.

methods.name: Topbar()
methods.description: React functional component that renders the top navigation bar with user-specific actions.

methods.name: onHome
methods.description: Navigates the user to the overview page.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Signs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: onLogin
methods.description: Navigates the user to login page.
